correctness.rationale: A leaf u with midpoint w yields successive dominated arcs w→v (by u→w) and v→w (by w→u); after removing them the opposite arcs on uw form an independent S0 join factor. Induction on the number of original forest edges gives the crosspolytope boundary via elementary collapses. Global arrow reversal has no invariant nonempty multipath simplex, so Lefschetz gives (-1)^m on top integral homology. Exhaustive independent finite tests checked 339 labeled/branching forests and each asserted local domination.
